dataset_layout: Kaggle auto-extracts uploaded .gz files. The runner verifies the decompressed content hash and accepts plain JSON or gzip.
integration_helper_note: The public helper is adapted from our dataset helper to accept either plain JSON or gzip after verifying the supplied file-byte hash.

metric.extraction: Concatenate code cell 0 source, then append exactly one newline.

rights_scope: Original portable code and explanatory text follow our dataset CC BY 4.0 notice. External sources retain their individual rights.

source_catalogue.credit_scope: Per-witness construction and nested source credits remain in the dataset source index; no blanket upstream reuse license is asserted.
